name: ES Opening Boundary Debt Repayment v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: A morning excursion beyond an opening-auction boundary creates no directional information by itself. If the morning participant group subsequently closes back inside the opening range, the rejected excursion is liquidity debt and price should repay it by traversing to the opening accepted-value center.

signal.opening_center: volume-weighted mean of opening one-minute typical price (high + low + close) / 3
signal.long_signal: rejection-window low is strictly below opening low and 11:29 close is strictly inside the opening range but below opening center
signal.short_signal: rejection-window high is strictly above opening high and 11:29 close is strictly inside the opening range but above opening center
signal.both_boundary_rule: if both boundaries were exceeded, the 11:29 close's side of the opening center uniquely determines direction
signal.zero_rule: no trade if no qualifying rejected excursion exists or 11:29 closes exactly at the center

execution.entry: 11:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.target: one ES tick before the opening center in the trade direction: center minus one tick for longs and center plus one tick for shorts
execution.stop: one adverse ES tick beyond the rejection-window extreme
execution.geometry_rule: skip unless target is favorable to entry and stop is adverse to entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if target and stop are both touched in one minute, assume the stop fills first
execution.gap_stop_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the stop, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
execution.survivor_exit: 13:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: The bounded repair engine achieved a 63 percent win rate, but its structural-stop losses overwhelmed targets and signal frequency was insufficient. The profitable long subset cannot be selected.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: changing the opening, rejection, or exit windows
requiring excursion magnitude, duration, volume, or bar-count thresholds
changing the value-center, target, or stop definitions
removing the target to chase trend-like outliers
side, weekday, volatility, year, or regime filters
